summary: Turn recurring work visible in conversations into decision-ready candidates for the smallest durable artifact.

scenarios.title: Find repeated manual work
scenarios.prompt: Use $capture-repeatable-work on my five recent completed project tasks and find recurring manual verification steps.
scenarios.outcome: A small set of evidence-backed candidates routed to the narrowest useful instruction, script, skill, or automation.

scenarios.title: Assess one expensive workflow
scenarios.prompt: Use $capture-repeatable-work on this conversation and decide whether the workflow is stable enough to productize.
scenarios.outcome: A read-only candidate or a clear rejection when the evidence shows only an isolated lapse or transient incident.
